title: helianthemum croceum var. flavum
intro: Helianthemum croceum var. flavum, commonly known as yellow rockrose, is a type of flowering plant in the cistus family. It is native to the mountainous regions of China and is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and evergreen leaves. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum croceum var. flavum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
